notes.title: Flight 732 has been launched
notes.notes:
It is official, Flight 732 is live and ready for you to get on the Steam Store.  Thank you to those that have followed it through its development.  I hope you enjoy playing it.  Leave feedback and I'll be sure to evaluate it for updates to the game.

Get Captain Sims and yourself back home safely.

-Ghere Games

notes.title: Get Ready!
notes.notes:
Flight 732 is just 10 days from official release pending store approval.  11 Achievements will be available. As well as local game saves, and hidden weapons and surprises.

Can you ration your supplies and fight off animals and more long enough to find a way to rescue you and your captain?

notes.title: T -24 Days Until Official Release
notes.notes:
Flight 732 is ready.  Testing continues and minor improvements to increase the player's experience are being worked on.  Early release is being considered for this title.  If you are interested, please leave a comment or Rate-Up this announcement.  Those will be considered in the decision to release early.  Thanks to those who have followed us this far!
web:  www.gheregames.com
Twitter:  @gheregames
